title: Rater Cohesion and Quality from a Vicarious Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating in-group and cross-group rater cohesion metrics (e.g., Inter-Rater Reliability, Cross-Replication Reliability, Negentropy) to evaluate how annotators' political affiliations (Democrat, Republican, Independent) influence their annotations of offensive and toxic content, as well as their predictions of vicarious offense for other groups.

Measuring in-group and cross-group rater cohesion metrics to analyze differences in offense and toxicity annotations between male and female annotators, including intersectional analysis combining gender with political affiliation.
